Symptoms of HMPV Infection
HMPV symptoms can range from mild to severe, depending on the patient's age and health. Common symptoms include:

Fever
Nasal congestion
Cough
Shortness of breath
Sore throat
Wheezing
Fatigue #HMPV https://t.co/nU
